description: Pydantic models for notes_backend API, defining data schemas for notes, tags, search, and versioning.

classes.name: TagOut
classes.description: A tag returned by the API.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Payload to update a note; any field may be omitted.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: Search request parameters (also used via query params).

classes.name: NoteVersionSaveIn
classes.description: Request payload to manually save a note version snapshot.

classes.name: NoteVersionSummaryOut
classes.description: A lightweight version entry for listing and selection.

classes.name: NoteVersionRestoreOut
classes.description: Response after restoring a version (returns the updated note).
